egyptian_official_document_copyright_bas.statute: Egyptian Intellectual Property Rights Law No. 82 of 2002, Article 141
egyptian_official_document_copyright_bas.observed_rule: Article 141 excludes official documents including laws, regulations, resolutions, decisions and court decisions from copyright protection; it also says collections may be protected where selection/arrangement or personal effort is creative.
egyptian_official_document_copyright_bas.assessment: Preliminary legal-source research note only. This supports treating the text of the enacted law separately from a portal's PDF scan, metadata, database compilation, and access terms.
